owner_statement_english_translation: The incident is ongoing. I still cannot work normally. I have not found a working fix on my side. I need Hermes maintainers and the provider to work together to investigate and fix this.
publication_scope: Technical fields, source hashes, per-attempt Codex ledger, diagnostic index and selected message excerpts. Private prompts, raw session exports and tool-output bodies are not published.
counting_rules: One failed API attempt is a conversation_loop API call failed (attempt N/M) record. Retry notices, terminal error summaries and exact mirrored records do not add attempts.
Exact mirror deduplication uses timestamp, level, session, logger and message; source references are combined.
unknown + request ID is an analytical bucket for An error occurred while processing your request with a request ID. No raw HTTP status is inferred.
Retry-series IDs group session/thread/provider/model and attempt progression. They are not independent user incident counts.
The 118 after-commit Codex attempts include 11–12 September events already discussed in issue #1; do not add this whole window to earlier issue counters.
Diagnostic index rows use different units and can describe the same operation as an API failure. They must not be added to the API attempt total.
Later successful calls or GUI complete records are observations in the same session, not proof of a permanent fix or completion of the identical failed request.
The detailed agent log begins only on 14 September at 18:18:42.598 UTC+3. A whole-window success rate, downtime total, quota consumption and account restriction cannot be calculated from this corpus.
Account tier and reasoning effort are left unknown for each new attempt; the 12 September issue comment has separate read-only DB evidence for that earlier Sol session.
